files.note: (account bindings; a character with character-specific key bindings on uses its own file instead [verify]. The server can replace this file at login when binding sync is on; see wowlab doctor)
(a character has its own bindings-cache.wtf only when character-specific key bindings are on [verify]; without one it uses the account bindings)

cannot_place: no action-bar record (schema 1 has none; install or update the lab-addon with the client closed (wowlab addon install lab), log in on this character, then log out or /reload; schema 3 is needed)
cannot_compare: no bindings record (schema 1 has none; install or update the lab-addon with the client closed (wowlab addon install lab), log in on this character, then log out or /reload; schema 3 is needed)
notes: A key reaches an action slot through the default UI's action buttons: button n of the bar showing page p is slot (p - 1) x 12 + n [verify]. The main bar is read at page 1 only, the page shown with no form, stance or stealth active; the pages shown by paging, a form, stance or stealth, or a possess, override or vehicle bar [verify], the pet and stance bars and an addon's buttons are not followed.
Without a bindings record only the files' lines are listed; a file may leave out keys at the client's defaults [verify], so keys not listed may still be bound.
WowLab.lua is written at logout, /reload or a clean exit (a crash writes nothing): this is the character as of that save, not the session in progress.
